<analysis>**original_problem_statement**: The user wants to build an interactive roster and management application for a Civil Air Patrol (CAP) encampment.

**PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS**:
*   An interactive roster with advanced Excel import functionality, now connected to a live Google Sheet for automatic updates.
*   Role-based access control (Commander, Finance, Plans and Programs, Executive Cadre, Staff, Cadre).
*   A live Financial Tracker that auto-syncs with the roster.
*   An Analytics Dashboard to display detailed metrics about attendees.
*   Pages for Handbooks, Schedule, and Official Documents.
*   A dynamic, interactive org chart populated from a live-synced Google Sheet.
*   A dynamic schedule populated via Excel import, with real-time updates and flight-specific views. Schedule events now include a Uniform field.
*   Push notifications for schedule updates.
*   A user profile system where members can manage their own information, pending admin approval.
*   Granular, per-user permissions to control access to specific application features.
*   A point tracking system for flights, squadrons, and individuals to manage awards (demerit option removed).
*   A My Flight page for flight-level roster, document, and point management.
*   Real-time tracking of active users on the application.
*   Self-service and admin-initiated password reset functionality.
*   A central repository for financial receipts.
*   Dashboard widgets for Uniform of the Day and Weather Flag conditions, editable by admins.
*   Roster and squadron names/colors should match the user's master Google Sheet.

**User's preferred language**: English

**what currently exists?**
A comprehensive full-stack application for managing a CAP encampment.
*   **Backend**: A monolithic FastAPI server () with JWT authentication, role-based access, and all business logic. It now includes a background scheduler () for hourly Google Sheets synchronization.
*   **Frontend**: A React application with role-based views, using Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI components.
*   **Key Features**:
    *   **Live Data Sync**: Roster and Org Chart data are now synced from user-provided Google Sheets hourly or via a manual trigger in the Admin panel. This includes automatic flight/squadron assignment for students.
    *   **Enhanced UI**: The Roster is color-coded by squadron, the Dashboard features new Uniform of the Day and Weather Flag widgets, and Squadron names/patches have been updated throughout the app.
    *   **Core Systems**: Roster management, Financial Tracker, Analytics Dashboard, Point Tracking (demerits removed), My Flight page, an interactive Org Chart, user approval, active user tracking, and a SendGrid-powered password reset system.
    *   **Schedule**: Events can now have a specific Uniform assigned.

{\n    touchEndX.current = e.touches[0].clientX;\n  };\n\n  const handleTouchEnd = () => {\n    if (!touchStartX.current || !touchEndX.current) return;\n    \n    const diff = touchStartX.current - };\n\n  const handleEdit = (event) => {\n    setEditingEvent(event);\n    setFormData({\n      title: event.title,\n      description: event.description || '',\n      date: event.date,\n fileInputRef.current.value = '';\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handlePublish = async () => {\n    try {\n      await publishSchedule();\n      setIsPublished(true);\n      toast.success('Schedule '../components/NotificationManager';\n\nconst AdminPage = () => {\n  const { user: currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [users, setUsers] = useState([]);\n  const [pendingUsers, setPendingUsers] = useState([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('pending'); // 'pending', 'users'\n  const [matchingParticipants, setMatchingParticipants] = useState({});\n  const [loadingMatches, setLoadingMatches] = useState({});\n  const [editingPermissions, setEditingPermissions] = useState(null);\n  const [permissionsForm, setPermissionsForm] = useState({});\n  \n  // Password reset state\n  const [resetPasswordModal, setResetPasswordModal] = useState(null);\n  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState('');\n  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');\n  const [resettingPassword, setResettingPassword] = useState(false);\n\n  const roles = [\n    { value: 'commander', label: 'Commander', color: 'bg-[#00205B] 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-200' },\n    { value: 'cadre', label: 'Cadre', color: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 border-slate-200' }\n  ];\n\n  const squadrons = [\n    { value: 'none', label: 'Not Assigned' },\n    { value: 'staff', label: 'Staff' },\n    { value: 'support_cadre', label: 'Support Cadre' },\n    { value: 'exec_cadre', label: 'Exec Cadre' },\n    { value: 'ops_cadre', label: 'Ops Cadre' },\n    { value: 'sq1', label: 'Squadron 1' },\n    { value: 'sq2', label: 'Squadron 2' },\n    { value: 'sq3', label: 'Squadron 3' }\n  ];\n\n  const flights = [\n    { value: ];\n\n  const permissionLabels = {\n    dashboard: 'Dashboard',\n    roster_view: 'Roster (View)',\n    roster_edit: 'Roster (Edit)',\n    schedule_view: 'Schedule (View)',\n    schedule_edit: 'Documents',\n    admin_panel: 'Admin Panel'\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    loadUsers();\n    loadPendingUsers();\n  }, []);\n\n  const loadUsers = async () => {\n    try {\n      const data = await getUsers();\n      setUsers(data);\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error('Failed to load users');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadPendingUsers = async () => {\n    try {\n      const data = await getPendingUsers();\n      setPendingUsers(data);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Failed to load pending users', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleApproveUser = async (userId) => {\n    try {\n      await approveUser(userId);\n      toast.success('User approved successfully');\n      loadPendingUsers();\n      loadUsers();\n    } {\n      const data = await findMatchingParticipants(userId);\n      setMatchingParticipants(prev => ({ ...prev, [userId]: data.matches }));\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error('Failed to find    setPermissionsForm(user.permissions || {\n      dashboard: true,\n      roster_view: true,\n      roster_edit: false,\n      schedule_view: true,\n      schedule_edit: false,\n      budget_view: setEditingPermissions(null);\n      loadUsers();\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error('Failed to update permissions');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleResetPermissions = async (userId) => {\n    try {\n      await resetUserPermissions(userId);\n      toast.success('Permissions reset to role defaults');\n      setEditingPermissions(null);\n      loadUsers();\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error('Failed to reset permissions');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleResetPassword = async () => {\n    if (!resetPasswordModal) return;\n    \n    if (newPassword.length < 6) {\n      toast.error('Password must be at least 6 characters');\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {\n      toast.error('Passwords do not match');\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    setResettingPassword(true);\n    try {\n      await adminResetPassword(resetPasswordModal.id, newPassword);\n      toast.success(`Password reset for ${resetPasswordModal.name}`);\n      setResetPasswordModal(null);\n      setNewPassword('');\n      setConfirmPassword('');\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error(error.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to reset password');\n    } finally {\n      setResettingPassword(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleRoleChange = async (userId, newRole) => {\n    try {\n      await updateUserRole(userId, newRole);\n      toast.success('Role updated successfully');\n      loadUsers();\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error(error.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to update role');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleUnitChange = async (userId, squadron, flight) => {\n    try {\n      await assignUserUnit(userId, squadron || null, flight || null);\n      toast.success('Unit assignment updated');\n      loadUsers();\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error(error.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to update unit');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSquadronChange = (userId, squadron) => {\n    const user = users.find(u => u.id === userId);\n    const actualSquadron = squadron === 'none' ? null : squadron;\n    // Clear flight if squadron changes and flight doesn't belong to new squadron\n    const currentFlight = user?.flight;\n    const flightInfo = flights.find(f => f.value === currentFlight);\n    const newFlight = (flightInfo && flightInfo.squadron === actualSquadron) ? currentFlight : null;\n    handleUnitChange(userId, actualSquadron, newFlight);\n  };\n\n  const handleFlightChange = (userId, flight) => {\n    const actualFlight = flight === 'none' ? null : flight;\n    const flightInfo = flights.find(f => f.value === actualFlight);\n    const squadron = flightInfo?.squadron || null;\n    handleUnitChange(userId, squadron, actualFlight);\n  };\n\n  const handleDelete = async (userId) => {\n    if (window.confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this user? This action cannot be undone.')) {\n      try {\n        await deleteUser(userId);\n        toast.success('User deleted');\n        loadUsers();\n      } catch (error) {\n        toast.error(error.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to delete user');\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getRoleBadgeColor = (role) => {\n    return roles.find(r => r.value === role)?.color || roles[2].color;\n  };\n\n  const getFlightsForSquadron = (squadron) => {\n    // Units that don't need flight assignment\n    const noFlightUnits = ['staff', 'support_cadre', 'exec_cadre'];\n    if return flights;\n    return flights.filter(f => f.squadron === squadron || f.value === 'none');\n  };\n\n  // Check if unit requires flight assignment\n  const unitRequiresFlight = (squadron) => {\n    const noFlightUnits = ['staff', 'support_cadre', 'exec_cadre', null, undefined, 'none'];\n    return !noFlightUnits.includes(squadron);\n  };\n\n  if (loading) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"p-6 lg:p-8 animate-fade-in\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-center h-64\">\n          <div className=\"text-slate-400\">Loading...</div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"p-6 lg:p-8 animate-fade-in\">\n      {/* Header */}\n      <div className=\"mb-8\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 mb-2\">\n          <Settings className=\"w-8 h-8 text-[#00205B]\" />\n          <h1 className=\"text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-[#00205B]\" style={{ fontFamily: 'Chivo, sans-serif' }}>\n            Administration\n          </h1>\n        </div>\n        <p className=\"text-slate-500\">\n          Manage user roles, permissions, and unit assignments\n        </p>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Tabs */}\n      <div className=\"flex gap-1 mb-6 border-b border-slate-200\">\n        <button\n          onClick={() => setActiveTab('pending')}\n          className={`px-4 py-2 <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 mt-1\">\n                            <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded border ${getRoleBadgeColor(pendingUser.role)}`}>\n                              {pendingUser.role}\n                            </span>\n                            {pendingUser.capid && (\n                              <span className=\"text-xs font-mono                   Registered {new Date(pendingUser.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}\n                          </p>\n                        </div>\n                      </div>\n                      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                        <Button\n                          size=\"sm\"\n                          variant=\"outline\"\n {loadingMatches[pendingUser.id] ?  </div>\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* All Users Tab */}\n      {activeTab === 'users' && (\n        <div className=\"space-y-6\">\n          {/* Push </SelectTrigger>\n                        <SelectContent>\n                          {roles.map(role => (\n                            <SelectItem key={role.value} <td>\n                      <Select\n                        value={user.squadron || 'none'}\n                        onValueChange={(value) => handleSquadronChange(user.id, value)}\n />\n                        </SelectTrigger>\n                        <SelectContent>\n                          {squadrons.map(sq => (\n                            <SelectItem key={sq.value} <td>\n                      <Select\n                        value={user.flight || 'none'}\n                        onValueChange={(value) => handleFlightChange(user.id, value)}\n                        disabled={!unitRequiresFlight(user.squadron)}\n                      >\n                        <SelectTrigger \n                          className=\"w-24 rounded-sm text-xs\" \n                          data-testid={`flight-select-${user.id}`}\n                          disabled={!unitRequiresFlight(user.squadron)}\n                        >\n                          <SelectValue {editingPermissions === user.id && (\n                    <tr className=\"bg-blue-50/50\">\n                      <td colSpan={7} className=\"p-4\">\n                        <div <Button\n                                size=\"sm\"\n                                onClick={() => handleSavePermissions(user.id)}\n                                className=\"rounded-sm text-xs                        </Button>\n                            </div>\n                          </div>\n                          <div className=\"grid grid-cols-4 md:grid-cols-6 gap-3\">\n                            {Object.entries(permissionLabels).map(([key, label]) => (\n                              <label key={key} className=\"flex items-center gap-2 p-2 bg-white rounded border cursor-pointer                       />\n                                <span className=\"text-xs text-slate-700\">{label}</span>\n                              </label>\n                            ))}\n <span className=\"text-xs text-slate-400 ml-auto truncate\">{member.position}</span>\n                        )}\n                      </div>\n                    ))}\n                  </div>\n                </div>\n              ))\n            )}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* Documents Tab */}\n      {activeTab === 'documents' && (\n        <div className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-2 text-slate-400\" />\n                  <SelectValue placeholder=\"Filter by category\" />\n                </SelectTrigger>\n                <SelectContent>\n                  <SelectItem value=\"all\">All Categories</SelectItem>\n                  {Object.entries(CATEGORY_LABELS).map(([key, label]) => (\n                    <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>{label}</SelectItem>\n                  ))}\n                </SelectContent>\n              </Select>\n            </div>\n            \n            {user?.role === 'commander' && (\n </DialogTrigger>\n                <DialogContent className=\"max-w-lg\">\n                  <DialogHeader>\n                    <DialogTitle className=\"text-[#00205B] uppercase font-bold\">Upload <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600\">Title *</Label>\n                      <Input\n                        value={uploadForm.title}\n                        onChange={(e) => setUploadForm({...uploadForm, title: e.target.value})}\n                        required\n                        className=\"mt-1 rounded-sm\"\n </SelectTrigger>\n                        <SelectContent>\n                          {Object.entries(CATEGORY_LABELS).map(([key, label]) => (\n                            <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>{label}</SelectItem>\n                          ))}\n                        </SelectContent>\n                      </Select>\n                    </div>\n                    <div>\n                      <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600\">Scope *</Label>\n                      <Select\n                        value={uploadForm.scope}\n                        onValueChange={(v) => setUploadForm({...uploadForm, scope: v})}\n                      >\n                        <SelectTrigger className=\"mt-1 rounded-sm\">\n                          <SelectValue />\n                        </SelectTrigger>\n                        <SelectContent>\n                          <SelectItem value=\"flight\">This Flight Only</SelectItem>\n                          <SelectItem value=\"squadron\">Entire Squadron</SelectItem>\n                          <SelectItem value=\"global\">All Flights (Global)</SelectItem>\n                        </SelectContent>\n                      </Select>\n                    </div>\n                    <div>\n                      <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide                 type=\"url\"\n                        value={uploadForm.file_url}\n                        onChange={(e) => setUploadForm({...uploadForm, file_url: e.target.value})}\n                        className=\"mt-1 rounded-sm\"\n                        placeholder=\"https://...\"\n                      />\n                    </div>\n                    <div>\n                      <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600\">Content (Optional)</Label>\n                      <Textarea\n                        value={uploadForm.content}\n                        onChange={(e) => setUploadForm({...uploadForm, content: e.target.value})}\n                        className=\"mt-1 rounded-sm\"\n                        rows={4}\n                        placeholder=\"Enter document content or notes...\"\n                      />\n                    </div>\n                    <div className=\"flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2\">\n                      <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" onClick={() => setIsUploadModalOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>\n                      <Button type=\"submit\" className=\"bg-[#00205B]\">Upload Document</Button>\n                    </div>\n                  </form>\n                </DialogContent>\n              </Dialog>\n            )}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Documents Grid */}\n          {getDocumentCount() === 0 ? (\n            <div className=\"bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm p-12 text-center\">\n              <FileText className=\"w-16 h-16 mx-auto mb-4 text-slate-300\" />\n              <p </div>\n          ) : (\n            <div className=\"space-y-6\">\n              {Object.entries(getFilteredDocuments()).map(([category, docs]) => {\n                if (!docs || docs.length === 0) />\n                      <h2 className=\"font-bold uppercase tracking-tight text-[#00205B] text-sm\">\n                        {CATEGORY_LABELS[category] || category}\n                      </h2>\n                      <span className=\"ml-auto text-xs text-slate-400\">{docs.length} documents</span>\n                    </div>\n                    <div className=\"divide-y divide-slate-100\">\n                      {docs.map((doc) => (\n                        <div \n                          key={doc.id}\n                          className=\"p-4 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors flex {doc.scope && doc.scope !== 'global' && (\n                                <span className=\"px-2 py-0.5 bg-slate-100 rounded-full\">\n                                  {doc.scope === 'flight' ?                         <span className=\"px-2 py-0.5 bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 rounded-full\">Global</span>\n                              )}\n                              {doc.version > 1 && (\n                                <span>v{doc.version}</span>\n                              )}\n                              {doc.uploaded_by && (\n                                <span>by {doc.uploaded_by}</span>\n                              )}\n                            </div>\n                          </div>\n                          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                            {doc.file_url && (\n                              <a\n                                href={doc.file_url}\n                                target=\"_blank\"\n                                rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\n                                className=\"p-2 text-[#00205B] hover:bg-[#00205B]/10 rounded-sm transition-colors\"\n                              >\n                                <ExternalLink className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n                              </a>\n                            )}\n                            {user?.role === 'commander' && (\n                              <button\n                                onClick={() => handleDeleteDocument(doc.id)}\n                                className=\"p-2 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-sm transition-colors opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100\"\n                              >\n                                <Trash2 className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n                              </button>\n                            )}\n                          </div>\n                        </div>\n                      ))}\n                    </div>\n                  </div>\n                );\n              })}\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* Points Tab */}\n      {activeTab === 'points' && (\n        <div className=\"space-y-6\">\n          {/* Flight Standing Card */}\n          {flightStanding && (\n            <div className=\"bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00205B] to-[#003087] text-white rounded-sm p-6\">\n              <div data-testid={`merit-${cadet.id}`}\n                      >\n                        <Plus className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n                      </Button>\n                      <Button\n         <Minus className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n                      </Button>\n                    </div>\n                  </div>\n                ))}\n              </div>\n            )}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Recent Activity */}\n          {recentMerits.length > 0 && (\n            <div className=\"bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm\">\n              <div '+' : '-'}{merit.points}\n                      </div>\n                    </div>\n                  );\n                })}\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          )}\n\n          {/* Link to Full Point Tracker */}\n          <div className=\"text-center\">\n            <a \n              href=\"/points\" \n              className=\"inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-[#00205B] hover:underline\"\n            >\n              <Award className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n              View Full Point Tracker & Leaderboards\n            </a>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* Merit/Demerit Modal */}\n      <Dialog open={isMeritModalOpen} onOpenChange={setIsMeritModalOpen}>\n        <DialogContent className=\"max-w-md\">\n          <DialogHeader>\n            <DialogTitle className=\"text-[#00205B] uppercase font-bold flex items-center gap-2\">\n              {meritForm.entry_type === 'merit' ?         </div>\n              \n              <div>\n                <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600\">Type</Label>\n                <Select\n                  value={meritForm.entry_type}\n                  onValueChange={(v) => setMeritForm({...meritForm, entry_type: v})}\n                >\n                  <SelectTrigger className=\"mt-1 rounded-sm\">\n                    <SelectValue />\n                  </SelectTrigger>\n                  <SelectContent>\n                    <SelectItem value=\"merit\">Merit (+)</SelectItem>\n                    <SelectItem value=\"demerit\">Demerit (-)</SelectItem>\n                  </SelectContent>\n                </Select>\n              </div>\n              \n              <div>\n                <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600\">Points</Label>\n                <Input\n                  type=\"number\"\n                  min=\"1\"\n                  max=\"100\"\n                  value={meritForm.points}\n                  onChange={(e) => setMeritForm({...meritForm, points: e.target.value})}\n                  className=\"mt-1 rounded-sm\"\n                  placeholder=\"5\"\n                  required\n                />\n              </div>\n              \n              <div>\n                <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide              className=\"mt-1 rounded-sm\"\n                  rows={2}\n                  placeholder=\"Reason for this merit/demerit...\"\n                  required\n                />\n              </div>\n              \n              <div className=\"flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2\">\n                <Button \n                  type=\"button\" \n                  variant=\"outline\" \n                  onClick={() => {\n                    setIsMeritModalOpen(false);\n                    setSelectedCadet(null);\n                  }}\n                >\n                  Cancel\n                </Button>\n                <Button \n                  type=\"submit\" \n                  className={meritForm.entry_type === 'merit' ? loadUsers();\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error(error.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to update unit');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSquadronChange = (userId, squadron) => {\n    const user This action cannot be undone.')) {\n      try {\n        await deleteUser(userId);\n        toast.success('User deleted');\n        loadUsers();\n      } catch (error) {\n        toast.error(error.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to delete user');\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getRoleBadgeColor = (role) => {\n    return roles.find(r => r.value === role)?.color ||  const noFlightUnits = ['staff', 'support_cadre', 'exec_cadre', null, undefined, 'none'];\n    return !noFlightUnits.includes(squadron);\n  };\n\n  if (loading) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"p-6 lg:p-8 animate-fade-in\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-center h-64\">\n          <div className=\"text-slate-400\">Loading...</div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"p-6 lg:p-8 animate-fade-in\">\n      {/* Header */}\n      <div className=\"mb-8\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 mb-2\">\n }}>\n            Administration\n          </h1>\n        </div>\n        <p className=\"text-slate-500\">\n          Manage user roles, permissions, and unit assignments\n        </p>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Tabs */}\n      <div className=\"flex gap-1 mb-6 border-b border-slate-200\">\n        <button\n          onClick={() => setActiveTab('pending')}\n          className={`px-4 py-2 {\n    touchEndX.current = e.touches[0].clientX;\n  };\n\n  const handleTouchEnd = () => {\n    if (!touchStartX.current || !touchEndX.current) return;\n    \n    const diff = touchStartX.current - };\n\n  const handleEdit = (event) => {\n    setEditingEvent(event);\n    setFormData({\n      title: event.title,\n      description: event.description || '',\n      date: event.date,\n fileInputRef.current.value = '';\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handlePublish = async () => {\n    try {\n      await publishSchedule();\n      setIsPublished(true);\n      toast.success('Schedule option.label : g;\n    }).join(', ');\n  };\n\n  const getUserUnitLabel = () => {\n    if (!user?.flight && !user?.squadron) return null;\n    const parts = [];\n    if (user.flight) {\n      const flight = targetGroupOptions.find(o => o.value === user.flight);\n      if (flight) parts.push(flight.label);\n    }\n    if (user.squadron) {\n      const sq = targetGroupOptions.find(o => o.value === user.squadron);\n      if (sq) parts.push(sq.label);\n    }\n    return parts.join(' • ');\n  };\n\n  if (loading) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"p-6 lg:p-8 animate-fade-in\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-center h-64\">\n          <div className=\"text-slate-400\">Loading schedule...</div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"p-6 lg:p-8 animate-fade-in\">\n      {/* Header */}\n      <div className=\"flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4 mb-6\">\n        <div>\n          <h1 className=\"text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-[#00205B]\" style={{ fontFamily: 'Chivo, sans-serif' }}>\n            Training Schedule\n          </h1>\n          <p className=\"text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1\">\n            TNWG Summer Encampment • July 17-24, 2026\n            {getUserUnitLabel() && (\n              <span className=\"ml-2 text-[#00205B] font-medium\">• {getUserUnitLabel()}</span>\n            )}\n          </p>\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2\">\n          {/* Real-time sync indicator */}\n          <div className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-sm text-xs ${isRefreshing ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-500'}`}>\n            <RefreshCw className={`w-3 h-3 ${isRefreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />\n            <span>Auto-sync</span>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Draft/Published Badge */}\n          {canEdit() && (\n            <div className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-sm text-xs font-medium ${\n              isPublished \n                ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200' \n                : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200'\n            }`}>\n              {isPublished ? (\n                <>\n                  <Eye className=\"w-3 h-3\" />\n                  <span>Published</span>\n                </>\n              ) : (\n                <>\n                  <EyeOff className=\"w-3 h-3\" />\n                  <span>Draft</span>\n                </>\n              )}\n            </div>\n          )}\n\n          {/* Show All Toggle (for editors) */}\n          {canEdit() && (\n            <button\n              onClick={() => setShowAllEvents(!showAllEvents)}\n              className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-sm text-xs font-medium border transition-colors ${\n                showAllEvents\n                  ? 'bg-[#00205B] text-white border-[#00205B]'\n                  : 'bg-white text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50'\n              }`}\n              data-testid=\"show-all-toggle\"\n            >\n              <Filter className=\"w-3 h-3\" />\n              <span>{showAllEvents ? 'All Events' : 'Filtered'}</span>\n            </button>\n          )}\n\n          {/* View Toggle */}\n          <div className=\"flex border border-slate-200 rounded-sm overflow-hidden\">\n            <button\n              onClick={() => setViewMode('day')}\n              className={`px-3 py-2 text-sm ${viewMode === 'day' ? 'bg-[#00205B] text-white' : 'bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50'}`}\n              data-testid=\"view-day-btn\"\n            >\n              <Grid3X3 className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n            </button>\n            <button\n              onClick={() => setViewMode('list')}\n              className={`px-3 py-2 text-sm ${viewMode === 'list' ? 'bg-[#00205B] text-white' : 'bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50'}`}\n              data-testid=\"view-list-btn\"\n            >\n              <List className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n            </button>\n          </div>\n\n          {canEdit() && (\n            <>\n              {/* Import Button */}\n              <input\n                ref={fileInputRef}\n                type=\"file\"\n                accept=\".xlsx,.xls\"\n                onChange={handleImport}\n                className=\"hidden\"\n                id=\"schedule-import\"\n              />\n              <Button\n                variant=\"outline\"\n                className=\"rounded-sm\"\n                onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}\n                disabled={importing}\n                data-testid=\"import-schedule-btn\"\n              >\n                <Upload className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-2\" />\n                {importing ? 'Importing...' : 'Import'}\n              </Button>\n\n              {/* Publish/Unpublish Button */}\n              {isPublished ? (\n                <Button\n                  variant=\"outline\"\n                  className=\"rounded-sm border-amber-300 text-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-50\"\n                  onClick={handleUnpublish}\n                  data-testid=\"unpublish-btn\"\n                >\n                  <EyeOff className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-2\" />\n                  Unpublish\n                </Button>\n              ) : (\n                <Button\n                  className=\"bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 rounded-sm\"\n                  onClick={handlePublish}\n                  data-testid=\"publish-btn\"\n                >\n                  <Send className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-2\" />\n                  Publish\n                </Button>\n              )}\n\n              {/* Add Event Button */}\n              <Dialog open={isModalOpen} onOpenChange={(open) => {\n                setIsModalOpen(open);\n                if (!open) resetForm();\n              }}>\n                <DialogTrigger asChild>\n                  <Button className=\"bg-[#00205B] hover:bg-[#001540] rounded-sm\" data-testid=\"add-event-btn\">\n                    <Plus className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-2\" />\n                    Add Event\n                  </Button>\n                </DialogTrigger>\n                <DialogContent className=\"max-w-lg max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto\">\n                  <DialogHeader>\n                    <DialogTitle className=\"text-[#00205B] uppercase font-bold\" style={{ fontFamily: 'Chivo, sans-serif' }}>\n                      {editingEvent ? 'Edit Event' : 'Add Event'}\n                    </DialogTitle>\n                  </DialogHeader>\n                  <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className=\"space-y-4 mt-4\">\n                    <div>\n                      <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600\">Title *</Label>\n                      <Input\n                        value={formData.title}\n                        onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, title: e.target.value })}\n                        required\n                        className=\"mt-1 rounded-sm\"\n                        placeholder=\"Morning Formation\"\n                        data-testid=\"event-title-input\"\n                      />\n                    </div>\n                    <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-4\">\n                      <div>\n                        <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600\">Event Type</Label>\n                        <Select\n                          value={formData.event_type}\n                          onValueChange={(value) => setFormData({ ...formData, event_type: value })}\n                        >\n                          <SelectTrigger className=\"mt-1 rounded-sm\">\n                            <SelectValue />\n                          </SelectTrigger>\n                          <SelectContent>\n                            {eventTypes.map(type => (\n                              <SelectItem key={type.value} value={type.value}>{type.label}</SelectItem>\n                            ))}\n                          </SelectContent>\n                        </Select>\n                      </div>\n                      <div>\n                        <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600\">Date *</Label>\n                        <Input\n                          type=\"date\"\n                          value={formData.date}\n                          onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, date: e.target.value })}\n                          required\n                          className=\"mt-1 rounded-sm\"\n                        />\n                      </div>\n                    </div>\n                    <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-4\">\n                      <div>\n                        <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600\">Start Time *</Label>\n                        <Input\n                          type=\"time\"\n                          value={formData.start_time}\n                          onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, start_time: e.target.value })}\n                          required\n                          className=\"mt-1 rounded-sm\"\n                        />\n                      </div>\n                      <div>\n                        <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600\">End Time *</Label>\n                        <Input\n                          type=\"time\"\n                          value={formData.end_time}\n                          onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, end_time: e.target.value })}\n                          required\n                          className=\"mt-1 rounded-sm\"\n                        />\n                      </div>\n                    </div>\n                    <div>\n                      <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600\">Location</Label>\n                      <Input\n                        value={formData.location}\n                        onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, location: e.target.value })}\n                        className=\"mt-1 rounded-sm\"\n                        placeholder=\"Parade Ground, DFAC, TR-1...\"\n                      />\n                    </div>\n                    \n                    {/* Target Groups Selection */}\n                    <div>\n                      <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600 flex items-center gap-2\">\n                        <Users className=\"w-3 h-3\" />\n                        Target Groups\n                      </Label>\n                      <p className=\"text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1 mb-2\">Select which groups should see this event</p>\n                      <div className=\"space-y-3 border {targetGroupOptions.filter(o => o.category === 'general').map(option => (\n                            <label key={option.value} className=\"flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer\">\n                              <Checkbox\n                                checked={formData.target_groups.includes(option.value)}\n                                onCheckedChange={() =>                   ))}\n                        </div>\n                        \n                        {/* Squadrons */}\n                        <div>\n                          <p    disabled={formData.target_groups.includes('all')}\n                                />\n                                <span className=\"text-sm\">{option.label}</span>\n                              </label>\n                            ))}\n                          </div>\n                        </div>\n                        \n                        {/* Flights */}\n                        <div>\n                          <p className=\"text-xs text-slate-500 mb-1\">Flights</p>\n                          <div className=\"flex flex-wrap gap-3\">\n                            {targetGroupOptions.filter(o => o.category === 'flight').map(option => (\n                              <label key={option.value} className=\"flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer\">\n                                <Checkbox\n                                  checked={formData.target_groups.includes(option.value)}\n                                  onCheckedChange={() => handleTargetGroupToggle(option.value)}\n                                  disabled={formData.target_groups.includes('all')}\n                                />\n                                <span className=\"text-sm\">{option.label}</span>\n                              </label>\n                            ))}\n                          </div>\n                        </div>\n                      </div>\n                    </div>\n                    \n                    <div>\n                      <Label className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600\">Description</Label>\n                      <Textarea\n                        value={formData.description}\n                        onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}\n                        className=\"mt-1 rounded-sm\"\n                        rows={2}\n                      />\n                    </div>\n                    <div className=\"flex justify-end gap-2 pt-4\">\n                      <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)} className=\"rounded-sm\">\n                        Cancel\n                      </Button>\n                      <Button type=\"submit\" className=\"bg-[#00205B] hover:bg-[#001540] rounded-sm\">\n                        {editingEvent ? 'Update' : 'Add'} Event\n                      </Button>\n                    </div>\n                  </form>\n                </DialogContent>\n              </Dialog>\n            </>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Draft Warning for non-editors */}\n      {!canEdit() && !isPublished && (\n        <div className=\"bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-sm p-4 mb-4 flex items-center gap-3\">\n          <AlertCircle className=\"w-5 h-5 text-amber-600\" />\n          <p className=\"text-amber-800 text-sm\">\n            The schedule is currently being updated. Check back later for the published version.\n          </p>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* User Unit Info (for non-editors) */}\n      {!canEdit() && user?.flight && (\n        <div className=\"bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-sm p-4 mb-4 flex items-center gap-3\">\n          <Users className=\"w-5 h-5 text-blue-600\" />\n          <p className=\"text-blue-800 text-sm\">\n            Showing events for <strong>{getUserUnitLabel()}</strong> plus squadron and all-hands events.\n          </p>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* Date Selector Tabs */}\n      <div className=\"bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm mb-4 overflow-x-auto\">\n        <div className=\"flex min-w-max\">\n          {encampmentDates.map((date, idx) => (\n            <button\n              key={idx}\n              onClick={() => setSelectedDate(date)}\n              className={`flex-1 min-w-[100px] px-4 py-3 text-center border-r border-slate-200 last:border-r-0 transition-colors ${\n                isSameDay(date, selectedDate)\n                  ? 'bg-[#00205B] text-white'\n                  : 'bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'\n              }`}\n              data-testid={`date-tab-${format(date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')}`}\n            >\n              <div className=\"text-xs uppercase tracking-wide opacity-75\">{format(date, 'EEE')}</div>\n              <div className=\"text-lg font-bold\">{format(date, 'd')}</div>\n              <div className=\"text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide\">{getDayLabel(date)}</div>\n            </button>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Event Type Legend */}\n      <div className=\"bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm p-3 mb-4\">\n        <div className=\"flex flex-wrap gap-3\">\n          {eventTypes.map(type => (\n            <div key={type.value} className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n              <span className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-sm ${type.color}`}></span>\n              <span className=\"text-xs text-slate-600\">{type.label}</span>\n            </div>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Day View */}\n      {viewMode === 'day' && (\n        <div className=\"bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm overflow-hidden\">\n          <div className=\"bg-[#00205B] text-white p-3 text-center\">\n            <h2 className=\"font-bold uppercase tracking-wide\">\n              {format(selectedDate, 'EEEE, MMMM d, yyyy')} - {getDayLabel(selectedDate)}\n            </h2>\n          </div>\n          \n          <div className=\"overflow-x-auto\">\n            <table className=\"w-full min-w-[600px]\">\n              <thead>\n                <tr className=\"bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-200\">\n                  <th className=\"w-20 px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600\">Time</th>\n                  <th className=\"px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-600\">Activities</th>\n                </tr>\n              </thead>\n              <tbody>\n                {timeSlots.map((slot) => {\n                  const slotEvents = eventsByTimeSlot[slot] || [];\n                  const isHourMark = slot.endsWith(':00');\n                  \n                  return (\n                    <tr \n                      key={slot} \n                      className={`border-b border-slate-100 ${isHourMark ? className={`${getEventTypeColor(event.event_type)} text-white px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs flex items-center gap-2`}\n                              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}\n                              data-testid={`event-${event.id}`}\n                            >\n                              <span className=\"font-medium\">{event.title}</span>\n                              {event.location && <span className=\"opacity-75\">@ {event.location}</span>}\n                              {getTargetGroupsLabel(event.target_groups) && (\n                                <span className=\"bg-white/20 px-1 rounded text-[10px]\">\n                                  {getTargetGroupsLabel(event.target_groups)}\n                                </span>\n                              )}\n                              {canEdit() && (\n                                <div className=\"flex gap-1 ml-1\">\n                                  <button onClick={() => handleEdit(event)} className=\"hover:bg-white/20 p-0.5 rounded\">\n                                    <Edit2 className=\"w-3 h-3\" />\n                                  </button>\n                                  <button onClick={() => handleDelete(event.id)} className=\"hover:bg-white/20 p-0.5 rounded\">\n                                    <Trash2 className=\"w-3 h-3\" />\n                                  </button>\n                                </div>\n                              )}\n                            </div>\n                          ))}\n                        </div>\n                      </td>\n                    </tr>\n                  );\n                })}\n              </tbody>\n            </table>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* List View */}\n <div className=\"divide-y divide-slate-100\">\n            {eventsForDate.length === 0 ? (\n              <div className=\"p-8 text-center text-slate-400\">\n                No events scheduled for this day.\n                {canEdit() && (\n                  <div className=\"mt-2\">\n                    <Button onClick={() => {\n                      setFormData({ ...formData, date: format(selectedDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') });\n                      setIsModalOpen(true);\n                    }} variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\">\n                      <Plus className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-1\" />\n                      Add First Event\n                    </Button>\n                  </div>\n                )}\n              </div>\n            ) : (\n              eventsForDate.map(event => (\n                <div key={event.id} className=\"p-4 flex items-center justify-between <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500\">\n                        <span className=\"flex items-center gap-1 font-mono\">\n                          <Clock <span className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n                            <MapPin className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n                            {event.location}\n                          </span>\n };\n  }, [loadSettings]);\n\n  // Touch handlers for swipe navigation\n  const handleTouchStart = (e) => {\n    touchStartX.current = e.touches[0].clientX;\n  };\n\n  const handleTouchMove = (e) => {\n    touchEndX.current = e.touches[0].clientX;\n  };\n\n  const handleTouchEnd = () => {\n    if (!touchStartX.current || !touchEndX.current) return;\n    \n    const diff = touchStartX.current - for selected date with filter applied\n  const eventsForDate = useMemo(() => {\n    let filtered = events.filter(e => isSameDay(parseISO(e.date), selectedDate));\n    \n    // Apply schedule filter\n    if (scheduleFilter !== 'all') {\n      filtered = filtered.filter(e => {\n        // Show event if it targets 'all' or matches the selected filter\n        if (!e.target_groups || 'foxtrot': 'sq3'\n        };\n        \n        // If filtering by squadron, also show events for its flights\n        if (['sq1', 'sq2', 'sq3'].includes(scheduleFilter)) {\n          const parentSquadron = flightToSquadron[scheduleFilter];\n          if (e.target_groups.includes(parentSquadron)) return true;\n        }\n        \n        return false;\n      });\n    }\n    \n    return filtered.sort((a, b) => a.start_time.localeCompare(b.start_time));\n  }, [events, selectedDate, scheduleFilter]);\n\n  const getFilterLabel = () => {\n    const option = scheduleFilterOptions.find(o {};\n    timeSlots.forEach(slot => {\n      grouped[slot] = eventsForDate.filter(e => {\n        const eventStart = e.start_time.substring(0, 5);\n        const eventEnd = e.end_time.substring(0,    seen.add(key);\n      return true;\n    });\n  }, [eventsForDate]);\n\n  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    try {\n      if (editingEvent) {\n        await };\n\n  const handleEdit = (event) => {\n    setEditingEvent(event);\n    setFormData({\n      title: event.title,\n      description: event.description || '',\n      date: event.date,\n });\n    setIsModalOpen(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleDelete = async (id) => {\n    if (window.confirm('Delete this event?')) {\n      try {\n        await deleteScheduleEvent(id);\n        toast.success('Event deleted');\n        loadEvents();\n        loadSettings();\n      } catch (error) {\n        toast.error('Failed to delete event');\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const fileInputRef.current.value = '';\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handlePublish = async () => {\n    try {\n      await publishSchedule();\n      setIsPublished(true);\n      toast.success('Schedule }\n  };\n\n  const handleTargetGroupToggle = (value) => {\n    let newGroups = [...formData.target_groups];\n    \n    if (value === 'all') {\n      newGroups = ['all'];\n    } else {\n      newGroups = newGroups.filter(g => g !== 'all');\n      \n      if (newGroups.includes(value)) {\n        newGroups = newGroups.filter(g => g !== value);\n      } else {\n        newGroups.push(value);\n      }\n      \n      if (newGroups.length === 0) {\n        newGroups = ['all'];\n      }\n    }\n    \n    setFormData({ ...formData, target_groups: newGroups });\n  };\n\n  const resetForm = () => {\n return option ? option.label : g;\n    }).join(', ');\n  };\n\n  const getUserUnitLabel = () => {\n    if (!user?.flight && !user?.squadron) return null;\n    const parts = [];\n    if (user.flight) }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8 animate-fade-in\">\n      {/* Mobile Header */}\n      {isMobile ? }\n  };\n\n  const handleRecordScore = async (e) => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    if (!scoreForm.category_id || !scoreForm.target_id || !scoreForm.points) {\n      toast.error('Please fill all toast.error(error.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to record score');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleRecordMerit = async (e) => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    if (!meritForm.participant_id || */}\n      <div className=\"mb-8\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 mb-2\">\n          <Settings className=\"w-8 h-8 text-[#00205B]\" />\n          <h1 className=\"text-2xl <NotificationManager />\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Role Permissions Info */}\n      <div className=\"bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm mb-6\">\n        <div className=\"border-b </h2>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"p-4 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4\">\n          <div className=\"p-4 bg-[#00205B]/5 rounded-sm border border-[#00205B]/20\">\n            <div const [users, setUsers] = useState([]);\n  const [pendingUsers, setPendingUsers] = useState([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('pending'); // 'pending', 'users'\n  const [matchingParticipants, setMatchingParticipants] = useState({});\n  const [loadingMatches, setLoadingMatches] = useState({});\n\n  const roles = [\n    { value: 'commander', label: 'Commander', color: 'bg-[#00205B] text-white' },\n    { value: 'staff', label: 'Staff', color: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-200' },\n    { value: 'finance', label: 'Finance', color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200' },\n    { value: 'cadet', label: 'Cadet', color: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 border-slate-200' }\n  ];\n\n  const squadrons = [\n    { value: 'none', label: 'Not Assigned' },\n    { value: 'staff', label: 'Staff/Cadre' },\n    { value: 'sq1', label: 'Squadron 1' },\n    { value: 'sq2', label: 'Squadron 2' },\n    { value: 'sq3', label: 'Squadron 3' }\n  ];\n\n  const flights = [\n    { value: 'none', label: 'Not Assigned' },\n    { value: 'alpha', label: 'Alpha', squadron: 'sq1' },\n    { value: 'bravo', {\n    try {\n      const data = await getUsers();\n      setUsers(data);\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error('Failed to load users');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n loadPendingUsers();\n      loadUsers();\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error('Failed to approve user');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleFindMatches = async (userId) => {\n    setLoadingMatches(prev (userId, participantId) => {\n    try {\n      await linkUserToParticipant(userId, participantId, true);\n      toast.success('User linked and profile populated');\n      loadPendingUsers();\n      loadUsers();\n      setMatchingParticipants(prev => ({ ...prev, [userId]: null }));\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error('Failed to link participant');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleRoleChange = async (userId, newRole) => {\n    try {\n      await updateUserRole(userId, newRole);\n      toast.success('Role updated successfully');\n      loadUsers();\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error(error.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to update role');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleUnitChange = async (userId, squadron, flight) => {\n    try {\n      await assignUserUnit(userId,   // Clear flight if squadron changes and flight doesn't belong to new squadron\n    const currentFlight = user?.flight;\n    const flightInfo = flights.find(f => f.value === currentFlight);\n    const newFlight = (flightInfo && flightInfo.squadron === actualSquadron) ? currentFlight : null;\n    handleUnitChange(userId, actualSquadron, newFlight);\n  };\n\n  const handleFlightChange = (userId, flight) => {\n    const actualFlight = flight === 'none' ? null : flight;\n    const flightInfo = flights.find(f => f.value === actualFlight);\n    const squadron = flightInfo?.squadron || 'border-[#00205B] text-[#00205B]'\n              : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'\n          }`}\n          data-testid=\"pending-users-tab\"\n        >\n          <span className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <Clock className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n            Pending Approval\n            {pendingUsers.length > 0 && (\n              <span className=\"bg-amber-500 text-white text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full\">\n                {pendingUsers.length}\n              </span>\n            )}\n          </span>\n        </button>\n        <button\n          onClick={() => setActiveTab('users')}\n          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium border-b-2 -mb-px transition-colors ${\n            activeTab === 'users'\n              ? 'border-[#00205B] text-[#00205B]'\n              : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'\n          }`}\n          data-testid=\"all-users-tab\"\n        >\n          <span className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <Users className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n            All Users ({users.length})\n          </span>\n        </button>\n        <button\n          onClick={() => setActiveTab('settings')}\n          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium border-b-2 -mb-px transition-colors ${\n            activeTab === 'settings'\n              ? 'border-[#00205B] text-[#00205B]'\n              : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'\n          }`}\n          data-testid=\"settings-tab\"\n        >\n          <span className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <Settings className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n            Settings\n          </span>\n        </button>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Pending Users Tab */}\n      {activeTab === 'pending' && (\n        <div className=\"space-y-6\">\n          {pendingUsers.length === 0 ? (\n            <div className=\"bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm p-8 text-center\">\n              <CheckCircle className=\"w-12 h-12 text-emerald-500 mx-auto mb-3\" />\n              <p className=\"text-slate-600 font-medium\">No pending approvals</p>\n              <p className=\"text-sm text-slate-400 mt-1\">All user accounts have been approved</p>\n            </div>\n          ) : (\n            <div className=\"bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm\">\n              <div className=\"border-b border-slate-100 p-4\">\n                <h2 className=\"font-bold uppercase tracking-tight text-[#00205B] text-sm\">\n                  Pending User Approvals ({pendingUsers.length})\n                </h2>\n              </div>\n              <div className=\"divide-y <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 mt-1\">\n                            <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded border ${getRoleBadgeColor(pendingUser.role)}`}>\n                              {pendingUser.role}\n                            </span>\n                            {pendingUser.capid && (\n                              <span className=\"text-xs font-mono                   Registered {new Date(pendingUser.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}\n                          </p>\n                        </div>\n                      </div>\n {loadingMatches[pendingUser.id] ?  </div>\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* All Users Tab */}\n      {activeTab === 'users' && (\n        <div className=\"space-y-6\">\n          {/* Push Notifications */}\n          <div className=\"mb-6\">\n            <NotificationManager />\n          </div>\n\n      {/* Role Permissions Info */}\n      <div className=\"bg-white border slots for day view (0600-2200 in 30-min increments)\n  const timeSlots = useMemo(() => {\n    const slots = [];\n    for (let hour = 6; hour <= 22; hour++) {\n      for (let min of [0, 30]) {\n  } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Failed to load schedule');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n      setIsRefreshing(false);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const loadSettings = (settings.version !== lastVersion && lastVersion !== 0) {\n        loadEvents(true);\n        toast.info('Schedule updated');\n      }\n      setLastVersion(settings.version);\n    } catch (error) {\n const handleTouchStart = (e) => {\n    touchStartX.current = e.touches[0].clientX;\n  };\n\n  const handleTouchMove = (e) => {\n    touchEndX.current = e.touches[0].clientX;\n  };\n\n  const (Math.abs(diff) > minSwipeDistance) {\n      if (diff > 0) {\n        // Swiped left - go to next day\n        navigateDay(1);\n      } else {\n        // Swiped right - go to previous day\n        navigateDay(-1);\n      }\n    }\n\n    touchStartX.current = null;\n    touchEndX.current = null;\n  };\n\n  const navigateDay = (direction) => {\n    const currentIndex = encampmentDates.findIndex(d => isSameDay(d, selectedDate));\n    const newIndex = currentIndex + direction;\n    if (newIndex >= 0 && newIndex < encampmentDates.length) {\n      setSelectedDate(encampmentDates[newIndex]);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const currentDayIndex = encampmentDates.findIndex(d => isSameDay(d, selectedDate));\n\n  // Get events for selected date\n  const eventsForDate = useMemo(() => {\n    return events\n      .filter(e => isSameDay(parseISO(e.date), selectedDate))\n      .sort((a, b) => a.start_time.localeCompare(b.start_time));\n  }, [events, selectedDate]);\n\n  // Group events by time slot for day };\n\n  const handleImport = async (e) => {\n    const file = e.target.files?.[0];\n    if (!file) return;\n    \n    setImporting(true);\n    try {\n      const result = await importSchedule(file);\n };\n\n  const handleUnpublish = async () => {\n    try {\n      await unpublishSchedule();\n      setIsPublished(false);\n      toast.success('Schedule unpublished');\n      loadSettings();\n    }   const option = targetGroupOptions.find(o => o.value === g);\n      return option ? option.label : g;\n    }).join(', ');\n  };\n\n  const getUserUnitLabel = () => {\n    if (!user?.flight && 'Documents',\n    admin_panel: 'Admin Panel'\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    loadUsers();\n    loadPendingUsers();\n  }, []);\n\n  const loadUsers = async () => {\n    try {\n      const data = () => {\n    try {\n      const data = await getPendingUsers();\n      setPendingUsers(data);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Failed to load pending users', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleApproveUser = async (userId) => {\n    try {\n      await approveUser(userId);\n      toast.success('User approved successfully');\n      loadPendingUsers();\n      loadUsers();\n    } {\n      const data = await findMatchingParticipants(userId);\n      setMatchingParticipants(prev => ({ ...prev, [userId]: data.matches }));\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error('Failed to find ...prev, [userId]: null }));\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error('Failed to link participant');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleRoleChange = async (userId, newRole) => {\n    try {\n      await updateUserRole(userId, newRole);\n      toast.success('Role updated successfully');\n      loadUsers();\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error(error.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to update role');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleUnitChange = async (userId, squadron, flight) => {\n    try {\n      await assignUserUnit(userId, squadron || null, flight || null);\n      toast.success('Unit assignment updated');\n      loadUsers();\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast.error(error.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to update unit');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSquadronChange = (userId, squadron) => {\n    const user = users.find(u => u.id === userId);\n    const actualSquadron = squadron === 'none' ? null : squadron;\n    // Clear flight if squadron changes and flight doesn't belong to new squadron\n    const currentFlight = user?.flight;\n    const flightInfo = flights.find(f => f.value === currentFlight);\n    const newFlight = (flightInfo && flightInfo.squadron === actualSquadron) ? currentFlight : null;\n    handleUnitChange(userId, actualSquadron, newFlight);\n  };\n\n  const handleFlightChange = (userId, flight) => {\n    const actualFlight = flight === 'none' ? null : flight;\n    const flightInfo = flights.find(f => f.value === actualFlight);\n    const squadron = flightInfo?.squadron || null;\n    handleUnitChange(userId, squadron, actualFlight);\n  };\n\n  const handleDelete = async (userId) => {\n    if (window.confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this user? This action cannot be undone.')) {\n      try {\n        await deleteUser(userId);\n        toast.success('User deleted');\n        loadUsers();\n      } catch (error) {\n        toast.error(error.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to delete user');\n      }\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getRoleBadgeColor = (role) => {\n    return roles.find(r => r.value === role)?.color || roles[2].color;\n  };\n\n  const getFlightsForSquadron = (squadron) => {\n    if (!squadron || squadron === 'staff') return [{ value: 'none', label: 'N/A' }];\n    return flights.filter(f => f.squadron === squadron || f.value === 'none');\n  };\n\n  if (loading) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"p-6 lg:p-8 animate-fade-in\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-center h-64\">\n          <div className=\"text-slate-400\">Loading...</div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"p-6 lg:p-8 animate-fade-in\">\n      {/* Header */}\n      <div className=\"mb-8\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 mb-2\">\n          <Settings className=\"w-8 h-8 text-[#00205B]\" />\n          <h1 className=\"text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-[#00205B]\" style={{ fontFamily: 'Chivo, sans-serif' }}>\n            Administration\n          </h1>\n        </div>\n        <p className=\"text-slate-500\">\n          Manage user roles, permissions, and unit assignments\n        </p>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Tabs */}\n      <div className=\"flex gap-1 mb-6 border-b border-slate-200\">\n        <button\n          onClick={() => setActiveTab('pending')}\n          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium border-b-2 -mb-px transition-colors ${\n            activeTab === 'pending'\n              ? 'border-[#00205B] text-[#00205B]'\n              : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'\n          }`}\n          data-testid=\"pending-users-tab\"\n        >\n          <span className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <Clock className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n            Pending Approval\n            {pendingUsers.length > 0 && (\n              <span className=\"bg-amber-500 text-white text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full\">\n                {pendingUsers.length}\n              </span>\n            )}\n          </span>\n        </button>\n        <button\n          onClick={() => setActiveTab('users')}\n          className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium border-b-2 -mb-px transition-colors ${\n            activeTab === 'users'\n              ? 'border-[#00205B] text-[#00205B]'\n              : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'\n          }`}\n          data-testid=\"settings-tab\"\n        >\n          <span className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <Settings className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n            Settings\n          </span>\n        </button>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Pending Users Tab */}\n      {activeTab === 'pending' && (\n        <div className=\"space-y-6\">\n          {pendingUsers.length === 0 ? (\n            <div className=\"bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm p-8 text-center\">\n              <CheckCircle className=\"w-12 h-12 text-emerald-500 mx-auto mb-3\" />\n              <p : (\n            <div className=\"bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm\">\n              <div className=\"border-b border-slate-100 p-4\">\n                <h2 className=\"font-bold uppercase <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 mt-1\">\n                            <span className={`text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded border ${getRoleBadgeColor(pendingUser.role)}`}>\n                              {pendingUser.role}\n                            </span>\n                            {pendingUser.capid && (\n                              <span className=\"text-xs font-mono text-slate-500\">CAPID: {pendingUser.capid}</span>\n                            )}\n                          </div>\n                          <p className=\"text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1\">\n                            Registered {new Date(pendingUser.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}\n                          </p>\n                        </div>\n                      </div>\n                      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                        <Button\n                          size=\"sm\"\n                          variant=\"outline\"\n                          onClick={() => handleFindMatches(pendingUser.id)}\n                          disabled={loadingMatches[pendingUser.id]}\n                          className=\"rounded-sm text-xs\"\n {loadingMatches[pendingUser.id] ? 'Searching...' : 'Find Matches'}\n                        </Button>\n                        <Button\n                          size=\"sm\"\n                          onClick={() => data-testid={`approve-user-${pendingUser.id}`}\n                        >\n                          <CheckCircle className=\"w-3 h-3 mr-1\" />\n                          Approve\n                        </Button>\n                      </div>\n                    </div>\n\n                    {/* Matching Participants */}\n                    {matchingParticipants[pendingUser.id] &&                   {match.participant.rank} {match.participant.first_name} {match.participant.last_name}\n                                </p>\n                                <p className=\"text-xs           <span className={`text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded ${\n                                  match.confidence === 'high' ?                  </span>\n                              </div>\n                              <Button\n                                size=\"sm\"\n                                onClick={() =>  </div>\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* All Users Tab */}\n      {activeTab === 'users' && (\n        <div className=\"space-y-6\">\n          {/* Push            <Select\n                        value={user.role}\n                        onValueChange={(value) => handleRoleChange(user.id, value)}\n                        disabled={user.id === ${getRoleBadgeColor(user.role)}`}\n                          data-testid={`role-select-${user.id}`}\n                        >\n                          <SelectValue />\n                        </SelectTrigger>\n                        <SelectContent>\n                          {roles.map(role => (\n                            <SelectItem key={role.value} <td>\n                      <Select\n                        value={user.squadron || 'none'}\n                        onValueChange={(value) => handleSquadronChange(user.id, value)}\n />\n                        </SelectTrigger>\n                        <SelectContent>\n                          {squadrons.map(sq => (\n                            <SelectItem key={sq.value} <td>\n                      <Select\n                        value={user.flight || 'none'}\n                        onValueChange={(value) => handleFlightChange(user.id, value)}\n <SelectValue placeholder=\"Not Assigned\" />\n                        </SelectTrigger>\n                        <SelectContent>\n                          {getFlightsForSquadron(user.squadron).map(fl </Select>\n                    </td>\n                    <td className=\"text-right\">\n                      {user.id !== currentUser?.id && (\n                        <Button\n                          variant=\"ghost\"\n                          size=\"sm\"\n                          onClick={() => handleDelete(user.id)}\n                          className=\"h-8 w-8 p-0 text-[#BF0D3E]                 </Button>\n                      )}\n                    </td>\n                  </tr>\n                ))\n              )}\n            </tbody>\n          </table>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Warning */}\n      <div className=\"mt-6 p-4 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-sm flex items-start gap-3\">\n        <AlertTriangle className=\"w-5 h-5 and unit changes take effect immediately. </div>\n      </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* Settings Tab */}\n      {activeTab === 'settings' && (\n        <div className=\"space-y-6\">\n          {/* Role Permissions Info */}\n <Shield className=\"w-5 h-5 text-[#00205B]\" />\n                  <span className=\"font-bold text-[#00205B]\">Commander</span>\n                </div>\n                <ul className=\"text-sm <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 mb-2\">\n                  <UserCog className=\"w-5 h-5 text-amber-700\" />\n                  <span className=\"font-bold text-amber-700\">Staff</span>\n </ul>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Unit Structure Info */}\n          <div className=\"bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-sm\">\n            <div
